paraphrase: The Maithili Varṇaratnākara includes, among its stock lists, a list of eighty-four siddhas that mixes names known from the Nāth tradition (Mīnanātha, Gorakṣanātha, Cauraṅgīnātha) with names known from the Buddhist siddha lists (among them Virūpa, Kāṇha, Jālandhara, Nāgārjuna, Carpaṭi).
notes: Recalled from secondary descriptions; the exact names, order and count must be checked against the edition (Chatterji & Mishra). Flagged in REPORT.md.
